quest.cobblemon_dimensions_stories.first: Mara has been watching you wander the outskirts of town. She says there is something you should hear before you go any further.
quest.cobblemon_dimensions_stories.gathe: The Curator needs raw material for his next batch of Poke Balls. Bring him eight apples from the orchard and he will make it worth your while.
quest.cobblemon_dimensions_stories.the_c: With the orchard run behind you, the Curator finally opens the back room of his closet. Whatever he keeps in there, he wants you to see it.
quest.cobblemon_dimensions_stories.the_n: Something walks out of the treeline after dark, and Mara refuses to move her stall. Clear the husks, break the archers on the ridge, and come back where she can see you.
quest.cobblemon_dimensions_stories.the_l: Mara has not walked past the second lantern post in four years. She wants to try today, with someone in front of her. Lead the way and do not lose her.
quest.cobblemon_dimensions_stories.relic: There is something behind the Curator's closet wall that has been quiet for a long time. He would like it to stay that way, and he is willing to trade for the help.
